description.value: Garden City Hot Pot is a Hong Kong-style restaurant in Richmond's Cosmo Plaza, serving traditional dim sum and hot pot dishes rooted in classic Cantonese cuisine. The restaurant bills itself as a 20-year establishment ("20年老字號") and offers a fully bilingual English and Chinese dining experience. Cyclists stopping in Richmond's busy Aberdeen area will find both dine-in and takeout available through an online ordering system and dedicated mobile app.

address.value: Cosmo Plaza, 8788 McKim Way #1205, Richmond, BC V6X 4E2

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 14m; rack (8 spaces) at 56m. Total: 16 spaces.
